# Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) Checklist: Standalone pages use the same content card

**Purpose**: Validate that accessibility requirements for the card are complete and measurable in both themes.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are text and link contrast requirements stated against the card background for each theme, with the colour pairs identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Is the 1.4.11 non-text contrast position for the border stated explicitly, including why a decorative edge is exempt and whether the light border is expected to meet 3:1? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are focus-indicator requirements defined for links and form controls near the card edge, so padding and rounded corners cannot clip them? [Gap, WCAG 2.4.7, 2.4.11]
- [x] CHK004 Are the landmark and heading requirements for the not-found content section defined (main landmark, single h1, section labelling) so the shared wrapper stays consistent? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Is the document order and reading order of the title, draft notice and card content unchanged and stated as a requirement? [Gap, WCAG 1.3.2]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "accessibility checks pass" defined as zero axe violations per template per theme, with the template list stated? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK007 Is "decorative edge only" defined so that no state or boundary meaning depends on the border or shadow? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Are forced-colours and high-contrast requirements specified beyond "the border stays visible", including the background and text pairing? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK009 Are reflow requirements (1.4.10) stated for 320 px width and 400% zoom with the reduced text column? [Coverage, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK010 Are text-spacing override requirements (1.4.12) addressed for text inside a fixed padded card? [Gap, WCAG 1.4.12]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements for the contact form's labels, errors and focus order unchanged and stated as such inside the new card? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Is the system-preference theme case (prefers-color-scheme with no stored choice) covered by the contrast requirements? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK013 Are print styles addressed, i.e. whether a shadowed card border prints, or is explicitly out of scope? [Gap, Edge Case] (n/a: the site has no print stylesheet for page layouts; recorded under Out of Scope)

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK014 Is the assumption that contrast is "unchanged" (white card on white page; dusk-800 as today) validated against the actual token values for links and muted text? [Assumption, Plan Constitution Check X]
- [x] CHK015 Is a requirement present that pages remain readable with JavaScript off, covering the card on all pages? [Coverage, Plan Constitution Check V]
